Cherry Margaritas
By: Karen Kelly
Published: Monday, May 14, 2018 - 10:53am

Ingredients




16 oz frozen pitted cherries, thawed overnight (save juices)
1 1/2 cups silver tequila
1 cup Cointreau
1 cup fresh lime juice
1 cup fresh cherry juice
simple syrup to taste or agave
limes and cherries for garnish

Preparation

1 Blend thawed cherries in a blender on high speed until pulverized. 2 Add all ingredients to a pitcher with ice and stir well. 3 Serve with fresh limes and cherries.

About

Craving a margarita right about now?  Me too!  Do it up right with these Cherry Margaritas that are full of fresh lime flavor and are made easily with frozen cherries.  Big batch Cherry Margaritas are perfect for spring and summer parties!
